summary: Sprint 9 WOW Onboarding: 18/18 backend tests pass (state/restart/flag, website analysis incl. graceful fallback, LLM profile + memory seed + 5 automations, PUT profile, seed-demo idempotent, demo-status, DELETE demo-data preserves Onboarding memories, checklist w/ non-demo counting, org isolation, regression on memory/opportunities/automation/crm). Full E2E playwright walk-through of steps 1-8 with a freshly registered user completed successfully — all 8 steps rendered, guards work (company_name required), analyze-website graceful on bad URL, discovery LLM completes and enables continue, brain edit+save works, 5 automation toggles present, demo counts populated (3 clients, 2 projects, 6 leads, 6 activities, 5 approvals), success screen shows 3 CTAs, CTA navigates to /ai-workspace and marks onboarding complete. Dashboard checklist + demo banner visible, user menu Restart onboarding present.

issues: Only 1 summary chip ('Business profile created') visible in the summary; onb-success-summary appears to render just a single chip in the tested run — consider surfacing more (e.g., memories seeded, automations enabled, demo workspace ready) to reinforce the WOW moment.

action_items: Optional polish: enrich onb-success-summary chips (memories seeded, automations count, demo counts) — currently only shows one chip.
Rate-limit note (not a bug): the 10/hr register+demo IP limit causes back-to-back agent runs to 429; documented in test_credentials.md. Consider allow-listing test IPs or raising during E2E.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.py DELETE /demo-data deletes ALL automation_approvals/logs for the org (not just is_demo-derived). This is by design per spec ('clears automation approvals/logs') but worth confirming — a user who has manually generated approvals for REAL clients before clearing demo would lose them.
analyze-website ignores robots.txt and uses a 10s timeout — acceptable for MVP, but flag for later hardening.
State endpoints do not validate step upper bound; a malicious client could POST step=9999. Non-critical but consider clamping.
